title: Posts
description: The posts you publish for yourself.

all.title: No post yet
all.body: Post for a server you manage, or for yourself if you are looking for a team.

published.title: No published post
published.body: A published post stays in the feed until it is closed or expires.

draft.title: No draft
draft.body: A draft does not count toward the limits and only you can see it.

closed.title: No closed post
closed.body: A closed post leaves the feed. You can publish it again.

hidden.title: No hidden post
hidden.body: The Moddy team hides a post that breaks the rules and gives the reason here.

row.hiddenReason: Hidden by the Moddy team. Reason: {{reason}}
row.hiddenNoReason: Hidden by the Moddy team. It can no longer be edited.

delete.title: Delete this post?
